text:
jess: looking for slow-burn TV to sink into this weekend (preferably <10 eps/season) + a tiny 3-song kitchen playlist to cook to. low-stakes drama or cozy mystery. any recs?
omar: For slow-burn, try 'The Bureau' (French espionage) or 'Rectify' if you haven't seen it. both very patient.
ting: oh Rectify is perfect for pacing. for cozy mystery, 'Miss Fisher's Murder Mysteries' is lighter and charming (short seasons).
ben: if you want odd + short: 'The Returned' (French original) — eerie and low-episode counts.
jess: nice, adding. any quick 3-song cooking playlists? something mellow but not sleepy.
kai: three songs i always rotate: 1) Khruangbin - "Time (You and I)" 2) Lucinda Williams - "Right in Time" 3) Alt-J - "Taro". chill but has lift.
marisol: cute list! my 3 for chopping/saute: 1) Toro y Moi - "Talamak" 2) Feist - "Mushaboom" 3) TV On The Radio - "Will Do"
omar: tiny breakfast cooking set: 1) Sufjan Stevens - "Chicago" 2) Arlo Parks - "Hurt" 3) The War on Drugs - "Red Eyes"
ting: if ppl want more upbeat 3-song set: 1) HAIM - "Want You Back" 2) Queen - "You're My Best Friend" 3) Chromeo - "Jealous (I Ain't With It)"
jess: these are great, thx! tiny poll: vote with emoji — slow/serious (Rectify/Returned) = :thumbsup:, cozy/light (Miss Fisher) = :heart:, foreign/spy (Bureau) = :eyes:
ben: :thumbsup:
kai: :heart:
marisol: :eyes:
marisol: also pro-tip: if you want to queue a 3-song set quickly on Spotify, create a playlist then use the desktop app to drag and drop the three tracks. super quick.
jess: can someone drop a spotify share link for one of the sets so i can just hit play?
omar: here's my chill cooking trio playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX7gIoKXt0gmx?si=example (swap tracks for your favs)
ben: posting a tiny cli trick for mac people who use mpv to play a spotify url (works if you have a local file):
```
# play local 3-song playlist
mpv ~/Music/3songset/*.mp3
```
marisol: also, if anyone wants a rec specifically for three-episode arcs that feel complete, DM me. i have a weird backlog of micro-series.
jess: will do marisol — thanks everyone! bringing Rectify + khruangbin tonight. :chef-kiss:
